changelog: PICRUSt2 runs to the end with the 2.6 command line: hsp.py had -i (trait) and -t (tree) swapped, metagenome_pipeline lacked -i/-o, and pathways were inferred from KO instead of EC. Outputs now follow PICRUSt2's own layout (EC_/KO_/COG_metagenome_out, pathways_out, *_descrip.tsv.gz). A .py change: uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.

previous.changelog: PICRUSt2: its helper programs (hmmalign, epa-ng, gappa) are found — the picrust2 env's bin/ is put on PATH for each PICRUSt2 step; place_seqs failed with "No such file or directory: 'hmmalign'". A .py change: uvicorn --reload restarts the backend, so deploy when no job is running.
